description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractHonoClientFactory' that provides a base implementation for client factory classes interacting with Hono connections. It manages connection lifecycle methods such as connect, disconnect, and listener management, and ensures that subclasses implement specific behaviors for connection handling.

classes.name: AbstractHonoClientFactory
classes.description: An abstract base class for implementing client factories that manage Hono connections. Handles adding disconnect/reconnect listeners, connecting, disconnecting, and connection status inquiries. Designed to be extended with specific client behavior.

methods.name: addDisconnectListener
methods.description: Delegates to the underlying connection's addDisconnectListener method.

methods.name: addReconnectListener
methods.description: Delegates to the underlying connection's addReconnectListener method.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Initiates a connection to Hono, returning a Future that completes upon success or failure.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active, returning a Future that completes if connected or fails with ServerErrorException.

methods.name: isConnected (overloaded with timeout)
methods.description: Checks connection status with a timeout for ongoing connection attempts.

methods.name: getDefaultConnectionCheckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration for connection checks, based on client configuration.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the connection, delegating to the underlying connection's disconnect method.

methods.name: disconnect (with handler)
methods.description: Disconnects the connection and invokes the provided handler upon completion.

methods.name: onDisconnect
methods.description: Protected method invoked when the connection is lost unexpectedly; meant to be overridden by subclasses.
